# "@path" in a prompt makes Claude Code read that file, and "@server:resource"
# fetches an MCP resource. Every "@" from the pane reaches the agent as a
# fullwidth "＠" instead, which the parser checks. The lines still read the
# same to a person.

# command: npx @babel/core
# caught: ＠~/.ssh/id_ed25519
# caught: ＠babel/core
# caught: me＠example.com
# caught: Any at sign in the output is shown as ＠ so it can't be read as a file mention.
# absent: @
